actions.action_description: Create a tiered coding agent setup in one existing repo: use Opus as orchestrator that receives natural language feature requests, delegates to Sonnet sub-agents for implementation, and uses Haiku for code review. Implement atom_06 (AI watchdog) to monitor PRs for duplicative code, missing tests, and doc inconsistencies. Document the pattern as a reusable skill/prompt for Claude Code.

Design a Chief of Staff + Director agentic org structure for the operator's business: one orchestrator agent (like 'Simon') managing 4-6 functional directors (operations, dev, marketing, finance). Map the three-tier employee model (atom_02) to agent autonomy levels. Produce an artifact showing the hierarchy, communication channels, and escalation paths.
